input.china_demand: 《天下3》是网易历时6年，耗资过亿开发的国内第一款绿色免费3D网游，也是网易第一款即时战斗MMORPG。 《天下3》是网易历时6年，耗资过亿开发的国内第一款绿色免费3D网游，也是网易第一款即时战斗MMORPG。它以女娲补天等上古神话故事为背景，以雄关蜀道等中华地理风貌为蓝本，处处充满浓郁的中国元素。玩家在游戏中，可以体验灵兽养成、元魂幻化等中国特色的创新玩法，并领略以中华副本和野外Boss为特点的PVE玩法以及以战场、势力战、城战为代表的PVP玩法。在《天下3》构建的虚拟社区中，玩家或标新立异不同凡响，或行侠仗义行走江湖，或号令众人攻城夺寨。 发展至今，《天下3》游戏中已经有了十一大门派，完善平衡的门派阵容和各具特色的技能搭配为玩家提供了丰富多样的玩法乐趣，各个门派兴衰历史、辗转起伏的往昔故事令人震撼、叹为观止。《天下3》的主线故事剧情格局恢弘、叙事连贯，玩家对在玩游戏时体验到的爱恨情仇、缘起缘灭，无不感到震撼非凡。而在玩法方面，玩家在游戏中，可以体验灵兽养成、元魂幻化等中国特色的创新玩法，并领略以中华副本和野外Boss为特点的PVE玩法以及以战场、势力战、城战为代表的PVP玩法。 除了恢弘的背景设定和优秀的玩法内容，《天下3》作为一款国风幻想3D游戏，其超强的3D美术设计和游戏内音乐制作在业界一直都位于顶尖最领先水平：场景真实，色调统一而不单调，显得场面格局整体和谐、气势磅礴一贯而终；整体配乐恢宏大气，极具感染力。 14年来，《天下3》凭借独特的山海国风美术、优秀的剧情塑造、爽快的PVP体验等，持续塑造一个史诗的国风大世界，甚至是顶级品质游戏IP，同时也赢得了许多品牌荣誉：中国民族网络游戏出版工程、百度风云玄幻网游、迅雷网游下载榜冠军、腾讯年度十大最受欢迎网游、净网先锋网吧最具人气奖、17173十大最受欢迎网络游戏、2012、2013、2014年度最佳运营奖、网吧最受欢迎3D游戏、最具人气网络游戏、2015年度中国网络文化风云榜风云产品、2016年金浪奖、17173游戏风云榜名游堂、2019年度中国游戏行业“金手指奖”以及2018年度中国游戏行业“优秀网络游戏”奖。 《天下3》是网易历时6年，耗资过亿开发的国内第一款绿色免费3D网游，也是网易第一款即时战斗MMORPG。它以女娲补天等上古神话故事为背景，以雄关蜀道等中华地理风貌为蓝本，处处充满浓郁的中国元素。玩家在游戏中，可以体验灵兽养成、元魂幻化等中国特色的创新玩法，并领略以中华副本和野外Boss为特点的PVE玩法以及以战场、势力战、城战为代表的PVP玩法。在《天下3》构建的虚拟社区中，玩家或标新立异不同凡响，或行侠仗义行走江湖，或号令众人攻城夺寨。 发展至今，《天下3》游戏中已经有了十一大门派，完善平衡的门派阵容和各具特色的技能搭配为玩家提供了丰富多样的玩法乐趣，各个门派兴衰历史、辗转起伏的往昔故事令人震撼、叹为观止。《天下3》的主线故事剧情格局恢弘、叙事连贯，玩家对在玩游戏时体验到的爱恨情仇、缘起缘灭，无不感到震撼非凡。而在玩法方面，玩家在游戏中，可以体验灵兽养成、元魂幻化等中国特色的创新玩法，并领略以中华副本和野外Boss为特点的PVE玩法以及以战场、势力战、城战为代表的PVP玩法。 除了恢弘的背景设定和优秀的玩法内容，《天下3》作为一款国风幻想3D游戏，其超强的3D美术设计和游戏内音乐制作在业界一直都位于顶尖最领先水平：场景真实，色调统一而不单调，显得场面格局整体和谐、气势磅礴一贯而终；整体配乐恢宏大气，极具感染力。 14年来，《天下3》凭借独特的山海国风美术、优秀的剧情塑造、爽快的PVP体验等，持续塑造一个史诗的国风大世界，甚至是顶级品质游戏IP，同时也赢得了许多品牌荣誉：中国民族网络游戏出版工程、百度风云玄幻网游、迅雷网游下载榜冠军、腾讯年度十大最受欢迎网游、净网先锋网吧最具人气奖、17173十大最受欢迎网络游戏、2012、2013、2014年度最佳运营奖、网吧最受欢迎3D游戏、最具人气网络游戏、2015年度中国网络文化风云榜风云产品、2016年金浪奖、17173游戏风云榜名游堂、2019年度中国游戏行业“金手指奖”以及2018年度中国游戏行业“优秀网络游戏”奖。 Simplified Chinese * * languages with full audio support

china_opportunities.value: Ever dreamed of creating a genre-defining masterpiece? Star of Games is a next-gen simulation management game centered on game dev. You'll act as an aspiring developer, starting from a humble garage startup and embarking on a glorious journey—from recreating classics to forging your own legends. FOLLOW US X: @Infini_Fun About the Game Have you ever dreamed of creating a game masterpiece that defines an era, or moves millions of players? Have you ever imagined standing shoulder-to-shoulder with gaming legends, carving your own name into the annals of gaming history? Welcome to Star of Games, a deeply immersive simulation management game centered around game development. Here, you'll step into the shoes of an ambitious game developer, starting from a small garage studio and embarking on a glorious journey—from recreating legends, to creating them, and ultimately changing the world. I. Forge Legendary Games: Start from the Genes In Star of Games, creating games is no longer just about combining genres. We introduce the revolutionary "Game Gene System", allowing you to delve deep into the soul of game design. Deconstruct Legends, Extract Genes : Place iconic titles into your "Gene Decoding Lab." Analyze the core of their success—level design, narrative pacing, game mechanics… everything can be extracted and become the foundation of your own creations. Recombine Genes, Create New Classics : Fuse unique gene sequences and integrate your chosen development philosophy—be it a "player-experience-first" craftsman's approach or a "tech-driven innovation" geek route. Every decision you make will shape the soul of your game. Deep Marketing, Ignite the Buzz : Move beyond simple paid promotions. Build your marketing team and strategize a campaign that engages players, media, and influencers. Will you create mystery, showcase boldly, use scarcity tactics, or rely on word-of-mouth? The market is yours to set ablaze. II. Build a Game Empire: Dance with Legends Personal success is just the beginning—building a great company is the real challenge. In the vast world of Star of Games, you are not alone. Encounter Legends, as Rivals or Allies : Well-known companies will be your inspirations, your competitors, and potential partners. Compete with them for Game of the Year, collaborate to gain tech licenses, or even participate in developing their legendary sequels. input.china_demand: See the world through the eyes of a brave little mouse in this enchanting 3D co-op adventure. Explore breathtaking landscapes inspired by Northern Sweden, solve puzzles, and be a force for good in a land where heartwarming storytelling and the beauty of nature intertwine. When the old can no longer protect the land, the small must learn to carry the tune. For as long as anyone can remember, a kind witch has cared for the forest and the creatures who call it home. But now, the world is beginning to fall out of harmony—and the witch who has always protected it is growing ill. Her smallest familiars must venture beyond the shelter of home and learn to carry the responsibility that once belonged to her. Though she cannot join them, her magic is never far away—a gentle hand, ready to lift them back to safety. Playing as a brave little mouse, you’ll journey through a vast world shaped by the beauty and wonder of Swedish nature, helping those you meet and restoring harmony one act of kindness at a time. Hela: of Mice & Magic is a heartfelt 3D open-world adventure about care, courage, and discovering how much even the smallest among us can do. Bros Survivors is a co-op Horde Survivor where you must survive hordes of enemies. You and your friend can fuse into a giant mech! The challenge: controlling the colossus together. One handles vertical movement, and the other controls horizontal movement. In this game, learning to coordinate your moves is the absolute key to making it through the rounds. If you crash into each other, you'll fuse into a giant mech. Shared Control: Now you're much more powerful, but your control is shared. One player moves side to side (Horizontal Axis) and the other moves up and down (Vertical Axis). Sounds simple? Try dodging massive hordes while your friend wants to go one way and you want to go the other! FACE HORDES OF ENEMIES CHOOSE YOUR POWERS FIGHT FINAL BOSSES UNLOCK UNIQUE CHARACTERS INCREASE YOUR POWER BETWEEN RUNS After each run, you can buy permanent upgrades to increase the maximum level your powers can reach, making you stronger with every new attempt. input.china_demand: Build and lead a colony on the surface of an endless Wall. Manage resources and your people, develop new technologies, defend against relentless zyrex attacks, and send robo-spiders on risky expeditions. Keep the colony from collapsing – in Wall World, it's easy to fall. The Wall is a colossal structure stretching far beyond the visible horizon, hiding traces of ancient eras and unexplained phenomena within its depths. Here, among stone, metal, and darkness, humanity has been forced to build a new life – clinging to the Wall and trying to survive in a world full of threats and mysteries. Wall World Strategy is a colony sim on a sheer vertical surface, where every decision affects the stability of the system. Build and expand your base, gather resources, take care of your people, strengthen your defenses, and send expeditions into distant regions and unexplored depths. Each new step forward brings not only opportunities for growth but also new dangers. Survival depends on your foresight, your ability to manage limited resources, and your willingness to make difficult decisions. BUILD AND EXPAND THE COLONY Establish a base on the surface of the Endless Wall and gradually turn a small outpost into a large, stable, and well-defended colony. Plan the placement of key structures, develop production chains, expand living areas, and build infrastructure capable of supporting both population growth and stable operations. As your colony grows, you will need to decide how to expand, which structures to prioritize, and where to allocate resources – whether into production, housing, or defense. WITHSTAND THE THREATS The Wall is far from lifeless. In its shadows lurk zyrexes – dangerous creatures that will attack your colony again and again, testing its defenses, organization, and your ability to respond. Strengthen your defenses, secure vulnerable areas, and decide how much you can afford to invest in protection. Additional pressure comes from emergency events such as accidents, disasters, and environmental hazards. They won't destroy your colony instantly, but they will disrupt its operations and trigger cascading problems. MANAGE YOUR SOCIETY Your colony is, above all, made up of people – living, working, hoping for the future, and depending on your decisions. Monitor their condition and take into account how they react to your choices. Overpopulation, food shortages, or supply disruptions can quickly lead to declining efficiency, crisis, and riots. Caring for your people is a core part of the strategy. The state of your population determines the performance of the entire colony – its productivity and its ability to endure prolonged periods of danger. A strong and well-supported society recovers faster from attacks and moves forward with greater confidence. GATHER RESOURCES AND ADVANCE Start with basic resource extraction and gradually build a more complex economy. Explore the depths of the Wall, search for stable resource deposits, and develop the infrastructure needed to use them efficiently. Technological progress allows you to improve core systems and unlock new possibilities. Enhance resource gathering and processing, reduce costs, increase efficiency, and strengthen your colony against external threats. Some technologies accelerate infrastructure development, others improve defense, automate key processes, or expand your ability to explore new areas of the Wall. SEND OUT EXPEDITIONS To explore beyond your colony, deploy robo-spiders – specialized machines designed for scouting, resource extraction, and operations in remote areas. Send them into uncharted sectors of the Wall to expand your reach, gather resources, uncover rare discoveries, and explore areas that are too dangerous or inaccessible for humans. However, distant regions bring not only opportunities but also risks. Expeditions may encounter hostile environments, unstable terrain, unknown lifeforms, or remnants of ancient machinery whose purpose has long been forgotten. Prepare your equipment, assess the risks, and decide how far you're willing to go. EXPLORE THE DEPTHS OF THE WALL The Wall is more than just the surface your colony clings to. Beneath it lies an entire world filled with resources, forgotten technologies, and rare artifacts. Extract valuable materials, recover technological samples that can accelerate your development, and uncover unique objects that help you understand this world. As you explore, you will begin to find answers – but each discovery raises new questions about the nature of the Wall and why it became humanity's last refuge. PLAY BY YOUR OWN RULES Develop your colony in Sandbox Mode without story constraints or time pressure. Choose from different maps and difficulty levels, tailor the conditions to your liking, and keep playing for as long as you want. Zyrexes will still attack, but you can play at your own pace and experiment with different development and defense strategies. input.china_demand: Your enemies are numbers. Your weapons are math. Reduce them all to zero. A twin-stick shooter roguelite where you subtract, divide, root and modulo your way through angry digits. Tuned to your skill level, from basic arithmetic to advanced operations. You failed math class. Math didn't forget. Zero Sum is a pencil-on-paper twin-stick shooter roguelite. Your enemies are numbers and your weapon is math. No health bars. No hit points. Just raw arithmetic violence. A "48" is charging at you. You fire ÷2. Now it's "24". Three more divisions: "12," "6," "3." Now switch to minus. Bang. Bang. Bang. Zero. Gone. Next. Wishlist now! The numbers are counting on you not to. Fight through different difficulties and game modes with a variety of arithmetic weapons. Face 9 different bosses based around mathematical concepts. Fine-tune your experience to your math knowledge level , from subtraction and addition, to division and multiplication, up to root and modulo. Enemies aren't just walking health bars. A prime number can't be cleanly divided. A factorial grows exponentially if you ignore it. Negatives force you to rethink. You can't outrun fast enemies. Don't just shoot, solve. Forget guns. You carry operators . Minus and Plus are your reliable sidearms. Precise but boring, until they save your life. Division rips through enemies. Root turns big numbers into rubble. Modulo nukes even the biggest numbers if played right. Multiplication ? A slow trap that slows everything it touches. Useful if you're smart enough to set up a kill with it. And then there's Sigma , turn a massive swarm of numbers into one big, easy-to-handle target. Seven operators. Twenty-two firing modes to unlock. Every shot requires a decision. Every clean kill and clever combo rewards bonus points. Integer split, perfect root, modulo blast. The game knows when you're showing off and rewards you for it. Every kill can be a clean kill. Divide a number into a perfect split. Root a perfect square down. Land a modulo that leaves exactly zero. The game tracks your math and rewards precision. Chain multiple clean kills for combo multipliers. Perfect wave? No misses? Bonus points. String together operations across different operators for Clean Combo Chains. The flashier the math, the better the reward. Sloppy kills still work, but clean kills let you progress faster and score higher. In Zero Sum, showing off pays off. Run one, you're rationing division ammo. Do you minus this 72 down shot by shot, or use your division for the perfect clean kill? Do you root the cluster of 16s for instant clears, or hold it for the tanky 256 barreling toward you? Run twenty, your chain-divides ricochet through swarms, your root shotgun pulps clusters in a single shot and your Sigma vortex eats half the screen. Permanent upgrades carry between runs. Temporary buffs stack within them. Every death makes the next run meaner. Standard Mode is the core roguelite loop. Chain smart math, build combos, aim for Perfect Waves, and fight through bosses. Die, learn, upgrade, repeat. Verdict Mode is a precision test. Each enemy requires exactly one correct operation — ÷, √, or %. A clean solve removes the number instantly. A wrong answer triggers consequences defined by the challenge author. No second chances. No spray-and-pray. Target Mode flips the script. Instead of reducing enemies to zero, you must transform each number into a specific target using +, × and Σ within a limited number of operations. A built-in reachability solver monitors every enemy in real time and flags impossible states on the spot, so if you're stuck, you know it's your math, not the puzzle. Zero Sum includes a fully customizable in-game challenge editor. Design custom math puzzles with your own wave sequences, enemy spawns, operator loadouts, traps, and resolution rules. Built-in validation catches unsolvable configurations before you export. Every problem set compresses into a compact share code. Copy it, paste it, send it to a friend, drop it in chat, post it online. Anyone can play your challenge, get graded on a Report Card and send their results back to you as a code. Set your own grade thresholds, write your own teacher name, add custom per-grade comments. Build challenges for your friends, your community, your viewers or for a classroom. The tools don't care who's playing. They just grade. Nine bosses, each built around a mathematical concept that wants you dead (a small selection): The Euler Owl a wise creature, firing Taylor series bullets that duplicate. Deal with them before the expansion overwhelms you. The Factorial Factory a stationary boss that launches factorial projectiles. 9! explodes into 9 × 8 × 7 × 6 × …, trying to recombine into their product. Reduce the pieces to zero before they merge. The Pi Boss a pie protected by digits. Each slice of pi must be dealt with to turn armor into weak points. The Yin-Yang Boss two spinning halves, one light, one dark. Focus too much on one half and the other goes berserk. Balance the harmony meter or get swarmed. The Prime Sieve Spider an eight-legged boss whose web is the Sieve of Eratosthenes. Identify and destroy the composites while avoiding prime traps. Hit a prime and it breaks free to chase you. Clear the web to expose a leg joint. Fail, and the entire web turns into a swarm. Zero Sum looks like your notebook came alive and got angry. Enemies are the doodles you drew when you were bored in math class. Except these doodles want revenge. Every menu is a school handout — quitting the game requires a permission slip. 7 operator weapons with 22 firing modes : every operator unlocks three to four distinct modes that change their behavior and your playstyle 100+ upgrade nodes across the operator tree: chain division, shotgun roots, area-of-effect modulo blasts, freeze lines, Sigma vortexes and more 9 boss fights built around real mathematical concepts: exponentials, prime sieves, pi, harmonic balance, factorials and more 3 game modes : Standard roguelite runs, Verdict precision challenges, and Target puzzle combat — each with unique operators, rules, and scoring Full challenge editor : design custom problem sets with wave sequences, operator loadouts, traps, and grading rules. Then share as compact codes and get graded on Report Cards Multiple arenas with different wave structures and layouts Roguelite progression : permanent upgrades between runs, temporary buffs within them. 3 difficulty modes for all knowledge levels with hard mode introducing additional boss mechanics Twin-stick controls with mouse + keyboard and full gamepad support A skill ceiling made of mental math . Zero Sum is a pencil-on-paper twin-stick shooter roguelite. Your enemies are numbers and your weapon is math. No health bars. No hit points. Just raw arithmetic violence. A "48" is charging at you. You fire ÷2. Now it's "24". Three more divisions: "12," "6," "3." Now switch to minus. Bang. Bang. Bang. Zero. Gone. Next. Wishlist now! The numbers are counting on you not to. Fight through different difficulties and game modes with a variety of arithmetic weapons. Face 9 different bosses based around mathematical concepts. Fine-tune your experience to your math knowledge level , from subtraction and addition, to division and multiplication, up to root and modulo. Enemies aren't just walking health bars. A prime number can't be cleanly divided. A factorial grows exponentially if you ignore it. Negatives force you to rethink. You can't outrun fast enemies. Don't just shoot, solve. Forget guns. You carry operators . Minus and Plus are your reliable sidearms. Precise but boring, until they save your life. Division rips through enemies. Root turns big numbers into rubble. Modulo nukes even the biggest numbers if played right. Multiplication ? A slow trap that slows everything it touches. Useful if you're smart enough to set up a kill with it. And then there's Sigma , turn a massive swarm of numbers into one big, easy-to-handle target. Seven operators. Twenty-two firing modes to unlock. Every shot requires a decision. Every clean kill and clever combo rewards bonus points. Integer split, perfect root, modulo blast. The game knows when you're showing off and rewards you for it. Every kill can be a clean kill. Divide a number into a perfect split. Root a perfect square down. Land a modulo that leaves exactly zero. The game tracks your math and rewards precision. Chain multiple clean kills for combo multipliers. Perfect wave? No misses? Bonus points. String together operations across different operators for Clean Combo Chains. The flashier the math, the better the reward. Sloppy kills still work, but clean kills let you progress faster and score higher. In Zero Sum, showing off pays off. Run one, you're rationing division ammo. Do you minus this 72 down shot by shot, or use your division for the perfect clean kill? Do you root the cluster of 16s for instant clears, or hold it for the tanky 256 barreling toward you? Run twenty, your chain-divides ricochet through swarms, your root shotgun pulps clusters in a single shot and your Sigma vortex eats half the screen. Permanent upgrades carry between runs. Temporary buffs stack within them. Every death makes the next run meaner. Standard Mode is the core roguelite loop. Chain smart math, build combos, aim for Perfect Waves, and fight through bosses. Die, learn, upgrade, repeat. Verdict Mode is a precision test. Each enemy requires exactly one correct operation — ÷, √, or %. A clean solve removes the number instantly. A wrong answer triggers consequences defined by the challenge author. No second chances. No spray-and-pray. Target Mode flips the script. Instead of reducing enemies to zero, you must transform each number into a specific target using +, × and Σ within a limited number of operations. A built-in reachability solver monitors every enemy in real time and flags impossible states on the spot, so if you're stuck, you know it's your math, not the puzzle. Zero Sum includes a fully customizable in-game challenge editor. Design custom math puzzles with your own wave sequences, enemy spawns, operator loadouts, traps, and resolution rules. Built-in validation catches unsolvable configurations before you export. Every problem set compresses into a compact share code. Copy it, paste it, send it to a friend, drop it in chat, post it online. Anyone can play your challenge, get graded on a Report Card and send their results back to you as a code. Set your own grade thresholds, write your own teacher name, add custom per-grade comments. Build challenges for your friends, your community, your viewers or for a classroom. The tools don't care who's playing. They just grade. Nine bosses, each built around a mathematical concept that wants you dead (a small selection): The Euler Owl a wise creature, firing Taylor series bullets that duplicate. Deal with them before the expansion overwhelms you. The Factorial Factory a stationary boss that launches factorial projectiles. 9! explodes into 9 × 8 × 7 × 6 × …, trying to recombine into their product. Reduce the pieces to zero before they merge. The Pi Boss a pie protected by digits. Each slice of pi must be dealt with to turn armor into weak points. The Yin-Yang Boss two spinning halves, one light, one dark. Focus too much on one half and the other goes berserk. Balance the harmony meter or get swarmed. The Prime Sieve Spider an eight-legged boss whose web is the Sieve of Eratosthenes. Identify and destroy the composites while avoiding prime traps. Hit a prime and it breaks free to chase you. Clear the web to expose a leg joint. Fail, and the entire web turns into a swarm. Zero Sum looks like your notebook came alive and got angry. Enemies are the doodles you drew when you were bored in math class. Except these doodles want revenge. You do the job that actually decides whether an airline lives: which city pairs to serve, how often, with which aircraft, and who is qualified to crew them. Start with one hub and one aircraft. input.china_demand: Welcome to Chinese Board & Card Games Museum. Step back into 1980s–90s China and play Dou Di Zhu, Guandan, Sichuan Mahjong, Ka Wu Xing, and more in 3D hometown scenes lit by your own clock. Practice against AI and rewind any move. Buy once, no ads. Welcome to Chinese Board & Card Games Museum Step back with us into the streets and courtyards of 1980s and 1990s China, where regional card and mahjong tables from across the country are gathered into one playable museum. Across China, the same deck of cards or set of mahjong tiles takes on different rules, names, and rhythms from one city to the next. Here, clear rulesets, cultural exhibits, and smooth tabletop matches live side by side. There is no required reading before you play—feel free to look around, sit down to a game you grew up with, or read an exhibit label and discover a game from another region. Every way to play has a hometown Inside the museum, we have recreated the local setting where each game grew up. Pull up a chair at any table, and you step right into the daily life of that city: Head to a Wuhan alley on a summer night to play Dou Di Zhu in the evening breeze; Visit a canal-side home in Huai'an for a partnership round of Guandan; Climb to an autumn rooftop in Changsha and race to empty your hand in Pao De Kuai; Step inside a Xiaogan main hall in winter to play Ka Wu Xing behind closed doors; Sit down in an early-spring Chengdu teahouse to play Sichuan Mahjong to the last tile; Or stay right by the Eight-Immortals table in the center of our museum hall for a game of Sheng Ji, played all across China. The lighting in these old streets follows your computer’s clock—lamps come on at dusk, and a midnight game means midnight outside the window too. Clear skies, rain, snow, or fog: you choose. Take a breather and the camera wanders the city for you. Prefer to focus purely on the cards? Switch to Simple Mode anytime to skip the 3D scenes and go straight to the table. Misplayed? Play it again Every move against the AI is recorded. Step back to any move, play it differently, and the game branches from there. The original line is kept, so you can switch back and compare at any time. Available in all six games. Branching sessions are for practice and do not count toward your match record. A quiet table We want to give you a quiet place to play. Buy once: no ads, no top-ups, nothing nudging you along. Guandan and Sheng Ji also include guided lessons, and Sheng Ji comes with a built-in card tracker. More exhibits on the way The free demo currently offers six games—Dou Di Zhu, Guandan, Pao De Kuai, Sheng Ji, Sichuan Mahjong, and Ka Wu Xing—all supporting Steam friend rooms (in testing). Early Access is planned for Q4 2026 and will continue to welcome more regional games beyond these six, with the initial lineup announced at launch. You're more than the operator behind the curtain. When the mood hits, you can jump in yourself, throw gifts, and fight the whole room for that number-one spot. A livestream management sim. As a group-stream talent manager, you take your streamers and you run. Numbers keep climbing until they stand on the national guild-championship stage. Of course, you're more than the operator behind the curtain. When the mood hits, you can jump in yourself, throw gifts, and fight the whole room for that number-one spot. input.china_demand: A tycoon game about building a racing factory from your garage. Scavenge, buy or design your own parts, fix cars, and climb every tier of motorsport. Balancing tight finances and decaying parts forces hard calls: repairs, upgrades, or paying the debts to keep the team alive. WORKS: Motorsport Factory is a top-down tycoon sim about everything that happens before a racing car reaches the circuit. Manage a motorsport team from the ground up: staff, facilities, car design and development while trying to stay competitive on a limited budget. Secure sponsors, hire mechanics, source parts and keep the operation running long enough to make it to race day. Five tiers of motorsport stand between your workshop and the being the most prestigious team in motorsport. Progress is not a straight climb - it’s a long-term struggle of financial pressure, technical setbacks and outperforming better-funded rivals. You manage the operation that makes the racing possible. Build the car. Prepare the spares. Manage the crew. Get the right driver in the seat. Load the truck. Get everything out of the factory and to the circuit before the departure deadline. While you wait at the factory the racing happens, watch the timing screens and wait. When the results come in your work begins again worn parts, crash damage and everything you learned about the car. Your crew goes to work. Deliveries arrive. Builders get back to work on the new section of the garage. Every job takes time. Every job needs someone to do it. Where you put things, who you hire, how your workshop is laid out and what your crew is doing right now all matter. The factory isn't a menu. It's a working place. Each part has a story. Each part has a lifespan. A brand new part at race one is not the same at the end of a season. Performance drops off, wear accumulates and eventually a part will fail. Run it too hard and repair it too much and it won't perform the same again. You can design parts for performance, endurance or reliability but getting the right balance to cover all three can be impossible Every part has a breaking point. Every part has a finite mileage lifespan. Every part has a performance drop-off that only reveals itself under real conditions. The better your facilities and the stronger your technical staff, the more of the truth you can uncover. And in a sport where tenths of a second matter, knowledge is often more valuable than raw performance. Five tiers of racing with many routes to reach the top. Whether it's from Karting to Open Wheel or Banger racing to Touring Cars, you're picking the route. Getting into the next series isn't just about winning. Drivers have careers of their own. Rivals develop. Sponsors can be offended. Contracts have teeth. Regulations change. Last year's dominance can become deemed illegal next season. You might have the fastest car and no money to run it. You might have the best driver and nothing worth putting them in. You might spend an entire season fighting for the last championship point that keeps the team alive. Grow from a workshop into a full constructor with a design studio, machine shop, wind tunnel and crash-test facilities. Design and develop your own cars part by part. input.china_demand: Historical War: The Animation is a library of classic-war animated reconstructions. Watch famous campaigns from Alexander to the Gulf War on a scrubbable timeline—play, pause, replay. Each film is about five minutes. Napoleon is the dividing line: earlier wars are Ancient, later wars are Modern. Animated reconstructions of classic wars Historical War: The Animation is not a real-time strategy game and not a sandbox wargame. It is a library of war films: famous campaigns reconstructed as short, playable records with play, pause, replay, and a scrubbable timeline. Napoleon is the dividing line. His campaigns and everything after are Modern Wars; everything earlier is Ancient Wars. Each film is about five minutes—long enough to follow the main axis of a battle, short enough to finish in one sitting. What you get Animated maps of advances, encirclements, retreats, and naval or air contact A timeline keyed to historical beats, with campaign notes Units that move along operational lines instead of appearing from nowhere Chinese and English interface, switchable at any time Ancient Wars Alexander the Great, the Punic Wars, Cannae, the Qin unification of China, Gaixia and Han Xin’s ten-sided ambush, Caesar, the Crusades, and the Mongol conquests. Who it is for Anyone who wants to see how a classic campaign actually unfolded on the map—history viewers and documentary-style war animation, not unit-command gameplay. input.china_demand: A stylish roguelike deckbuilder where two heroes fight as one. Weave cross-combos, parry to hold the line, and unleash Unison finishers as you sail a collapsing multiverse — retreading a fixed fate, again and again, to gather the Echoes of a lost truth. NEOVERSE 2 is a stylish roguelike deckbuilder built around a single idea: a pair is stronger than the sum of two heroes . Pick two of several heroes, share one deck, and fight in a timeline where every card you play sets up the one your partner plays next. When Resonance peaks, trigger Unison and end the fight with a finisher only your pair can perform. Combo — chain cards across both heroes to build Resonance and unlock Unison. Parry — read the enemy's intent and match it exactly to turn damage into momentum. Tempo — every turn of the battle runs on the timeline. Push, pull and swap turns to steal the rhythm. Naya overheats her weapons until they burst. Claire balances faith and bloodlust. Helena commands three beasts. Lucy, a new hero, wields multiple weapons and manipulates the timeline. Every pair plays differently, and every pair has its own Unison finisher. Power in NEOVERSE 2 comes from Echoes : fragments of lost timelines you fit into a limited budget. Build around a pair, not a character. Rebuild it between every fight. Chart a branching course across seven worlds — Terra, Pantheon, Nocturne, Cogito, Mirage, Requiem and the Nameless — each with its own residents, threats and a boss that remembers you. Cross the Transcendence Gate and venture into the deeper abyss. The truth is scattered across Echoes, events, cards and the things your partner says when you both survive. Retread the same orbit run after run, and the pieces, like severed time, meet again and join. Experience explosive synergy born from your choices, your focus — and a little luck. input.china_demand: In the summer of 2032, fourteen-year-old Lin Haoyang receives a box of old photographs sent by his father from Xi'an. Sorting albums, identifying faces, and completing the family tree, he slowly pieces together a century of memories of an ordinary Chinese family over six summer days. 2032. Summer. Fourteen-year-old Lin Haoyang is spending the summer alone in Shanghai. His mother is on a business trip in Japan; his father has gone back to the family home to arrange his great-grandmother's funeral. Then a box arrives from home: an empty album, a document bag, and a bundle of old black-and-white photographs. "You've got nothing better to do this summer. Sort these into albums for me." So Haoyang begins, one photograph at a time. He has never met most of the people in them, and the world they belonged to feels very far away. But every photograph, every letter, every old document points toward the story of one family. Tracing a family through old photographs · Sort the photographs: place more than 160 photographs into the right spots in the family album. · Identify the portraits: click on the people in the photographs to extract their portraits, and use the clues to identify them. · Follow the clues: read memoirs, notes, identity papers, old letters, and newspaper clippings for the details time has buried. · Complete the family tree: match the names you collect to the portraits, fill in the family tree, and untangle the relationships between generations. · Talk to the family: open your phone and ask relatives about the stories behind the photographs. · Look things up: browse Kiwi Wiki for the objects, places, and eras in the photographs—or put on a record and take your time. A century of memories, one ordinary family The story told by these old photographs runs from 1915 to 1985. A village in Hebei, an apprentice's workshop in Tianjin, the hide trade in Shanxi, an old house in Xi'an, a new life after reform and opening-up... The joys and sorrows of an ordinary Chinese family are scattered across photographs, documents, and the stories relatives tell. Across six summer days, six batches of photographs arrive. There are no countdowns and no fail states. You can spend a quiet summer afternoon looking at one photograph, getting to know one person. In the end In these old black-and-white photographs, the youth they have lost remains. And there, too, is the place we ourselves came from. Content note: the story deals with the death of a family member and twentieth-century Chinese history. There is no graphic violence. A note for English players This game features a great deal of Chinese culture and customs. Players outside the Chinese cultural sphere may find some references difficult to understand. merged_final_input.china_demand: 《天下3》是网易历时6年，耗资过亿开发的国内第一款绿色免费3D网游，也是网易第一款即时战斗MMORPG。 《天下3》是网易历时6年，耗资过亿开发的国内第一款绿色免费3D网游，也是网易第一款即时战斗MMORPG。它以女娲补天等上古神话故事为背景，以雄关蜀道等中华地理风貌为蓝本，处处充满浓郁的中国元素。玩家在游戏中，可以体验灵兽养成、元魂幻化等中国特色的创新玩法，并领略以中华副本和野外Boss为特点的PVE玩法以及以战场、势力战、城战为代表的PVP玩法。在《天下3》构建的虚拟社区中，玩家或标新立异不同凡响，或行侠仗义行走江湖，或号令众人攻城夺寨。 发展至今，《天下3》游戏中已经有了十一大门派，完善平衡的门派阵容和各具特色的技能搭配为玩家提供了丰富多样的玩法乐趣，各个门派兴衰历史、辗转起伏的往昔故事令人震撼、叹为观止。《天下3》的主线故事剧情格局恢弘、叙事连贯，玩家对在玩游戏时体验到的爱恨情仇、缘起缘灭，无不感到震撼非凡。而在玩法方面，玩家在游戏中，可以体验灵兽养成、元魂幻化等中国特色的创新玩法，并领略以中华副本和野外Boss为特点的PVE玩法以及以战场、势力战、城战为代表的PVP玩法。 除了恢弘的背景设定和优秀的玩法内容，《天下3》作为一款国风幻想3D游戏，其超强的3D美术设计和游戏内音乐制作在业界一直都位于顶尖最领先水平：场景真实，色调统一而不单调，显得场面格局整体和谐、气势磅礴一贯而终；整体配乐恢宏大气，极具感染力。 14年来，《天下3》凭借独特的山海国风美术、优秀的剧情塑造、爽快的PVP体验等，持续塑造一个史诗的国风大世界，甚至是顶级品质游戏IP，同时也赢得了许多品牌荣誉：中国民族网络游戏出版工程、百度风云玄幻网游、迅雷网游下载榜冠军、腾讯年度十大最受欢迎网游、净网先锋网吧最具人气奖、17173十大最受欢迎网络游戏、2012、2013、2014年度最佳运营奖、网吧最受欢迎3D游戏、最具人气网络游戏、2015年度中国网络文化风云榜风云产品、2016年金浪奖、17173游戏风云榜名游堂、2019年度中国游戏行业“金手指奖”以及2018年度中国游戏行业“优秀网络游戏”奖。 《天下3》是网易历时6年，耗资过亿开发的国内第一款绿色免费3D网游，也是网易第一款即时战斗MMORPG。它以女娲补天等上古神话故事为背景，以雄关蜀道等中华地理风貌为蓝本，处处充满浓郁的中国元素。玩家在游戏中，可以体验灵兽养成、元魂幻化等中国特色的创新玩法，并领略以中华副本和野外Boss为特点的PVE玩法以及以战场、势力战、城战为代表的PVP玩法。在《天下3》构建的虚拟社区中，玩家或标新立异不同凡响，或行侠仗义行走江湖，或号令众人攻城夺寨。 发展至今，《天下3》游戏中已经有了十一大门派，完善平衡的门派阵容和各具特色的技能搭配为玩家提供了丰富多样的玩法乐趣，各个门派兴衰历史、辗转起伏的往昔故事令人震撼、叹为观止。《天下3》的主线故事剧情格局恢弘、叙事连贯，玩家对在玩游戏时体验到的爱恨情仇、缘起缘灭，无不感到震撼非凡。而在玩法方面，玩家在游戏中，可以体验灵兽养成、元魂幻化等中国特色的创新玩法，并领略以中华副本和野外Boss为特点的PVE玩法以及以战场、势力战、城战为代表的PVP玩法。 除了恢弘的背景设定和优秀的玩法内容，《天下3》作为一款国风幻想3D游戏，其超强的3D美术设计和游戏内音乐制作在业界一直都位于顶尖最领先水平：场景真实，色调统一而不单调，显得场面格局整体和谐、气势磅礴一贯而终；整体配乐恢宏大气，极具感染力。 14年来，《天下3》凭借独特的山海国风美术、优秀的剧情塑造、爽快的PVP体验等，持续塑造一个史诗的国风大世界，甚至是顶级品质游戏IP，同时也赢得了许多品牌荣誉：中国民族网络游戏出版工程、百度风云玄幻网游、迅雷网游下载榜冠军、腾讯年度十大最受欢迎网游、净网先锋网吧最具人气奖、17173十大最受欢迎网络游戏、2012、2013、2014年度最佳运营奖、网吧最受欢迎3D游戏、最具人气网络游戏、2015年度中国网络文化风云榜风云产品、2016年金浪奖、17173游戏风云榜名游堂、2019年度中国游戏行业“金手指奖”以及2018年度中国游戏行业“优秀网络游戏”奖。 Simplified Chinese * * languages with full audio support
